record.provider: RUVDS "Большой диск" / СХД — Russian flat-rate disk VPS with unlimited traffic

free_tier.stated: СХД Старт 1,023 ₽/mo for 1,024 GB; СХД Стандарт 1,899 ₽/mo for 2,048 GB; СХД Премиум 3,798 ₽/mo for 4,096 GB. Line advertised «от 1 до 18 Терабайт». Landing headline: «всего 500₽ за 1 Тб/мес».

egress.terms: Unlimited. Every СХД configuration lists its channel (up to 100 Mbit/s on the entry tiers) with no traffic meter, and the service is sold as a VPS so the rail is the VPS's own port. No per-GB charge exists.

record.tooling: Full KVM virtual private server supporting SSH, SFTP, rsync, rclone, NFS, Samba, and self-hosted services like MinIO or Nextcloud. Users manage the complete software stack.
record.chaining: Config-doubling ladder up to 18 TB; 20 TB requires two units or a different product. Each 1 TB step costs the same per TB from 2 TB upward.
record.limits_note: The 500 RUB per 1 TB monthly headline is not the direct price of storage plans. The lowest standalone 1 TB plan costs 1,023 RUB. The 500 RUB rate refers to a base VPS plus an add-on disk in the configurator. Network port is 100 Mbit/s on the entry tier, providing approximately 1 TB per day theoretical bandwidth (~32 TB per month).
record.reliability_note: Long-established Russian host (ruvds.com), KVM, own DCs. No independent benchmark of the СХД disk subsystem was found.

record.price_per_tb_month: $11.50/TB/mo at 2 TB ($23.00/mo) and 4 TB ($46.00/mo); $12.39/TB/mo at 1 TB ($12.39/mo). At 20 TB: ~$11.50/TB/mo if two 10 TB-class configs are assembled ($230/mo), derived not quoted. Unlimited traffic, $0 egress.

free_tier.stated: A 3-day free trial of any configuration costing under RUB 3,000 a month, including a hand-built configuration, with one IP address and any data-centre location in the configurator. A new user needs only a phone number and an email address to register and the trial is switched on with a toggle at order time.

retention.stated: The trial is three days and one IP address on a server priced under RUB 3,000 a month, so it is long enough to measure latency and short enough to build nothing on.

egress.terms: unlimited traffic, no overage price: the page states a channel of up to 300 Mbit/s with unlimited traffic (Russian: безлимитным трафиком)

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: Three days on a 2-vCPU / 2-GiB Russian box is enough to measure round-trip time from a target market and to confirm whether an outbound route exists, and it is not enough to run a crawl.

identity_cost.detail: a phone number and an email address, and nothing more: the trial page states registration needs only a phone number and email, and the trial is switched on with a toggle at order time. No card is required for the trial, so no hold exists. Whether the phone must be Russian is not stated in the evidence; the record's notes call it an any-phone gate, which is why the kind is not country-phone. For paid plans a third party reports foreign cards are accepted through a 'Card PaymentNut' option settling in USD, covering Visa, MasterCard, AMEX, JCB, UnionPay, Discover and Diners, reported

record.notes: The identity cost is the notable part: this is an any-phone gate, not a passport gate, which makes it one of the few Russian providers an individual outside Russia can reach at all. The trial needs no card, which is unusual. It is still a 3-day window, so it is a measurement tool rather than capacity.
